Belgian PM's Chocolate India Gate Gift Melts En Route to Modi

Belgian Prime Minister Alexander De Croo brought a replica of India Gate made of chocolate as a gift for Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi. However, the chocolate replica melted during the journey to India. De Croo reportedly made a lighthearted remark about the gift not lasting like the original India Gate.
